annotations.title: Check if a store is ready for AI shopping agents

description: Use this when someone asks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or other AI shopping agents can find, read and recommend their online store's products. Checks what robots.txt tells AI search crawlers versus training-only crawlers, llms.txt, agents.md, the UCP commerce discovery file, and one product page's structured data (price, currency, stock, brand, GTIN or SKU, reviews, shipping and returns). Returns the gaps with fixes, compared with 7IT's study of US online stores. Uses an identified crawler that respects robots.txt.

product_url.description: A product page on the same store to test; otherwise one is found from the home page

name: check_ai_shopper_readiness

benchmark.description: The 7IT study this is compared with

blocks_ai_search.description: AI search and shopping crawlers robots.txt blocks

fixes.description: What to fix, most important first

readable.description: False if the store refused or disallows identified crawlers
